description.value:
Beads of someone else's fluid, encysted along the veins. They were put there.

Gift — Once per day, no action: draw on a bead and regain HP equal to twice your level. Tithe — They are finite and they are not yours. The GM tracks how many remain and does not tell you the number. When they run out, you are told what you have been running on.

cinderfall.incomplete: The finite, GM-tracked-and-hidden healing-bead pool (each use heals twice the actor's level, no action) has no rule-element equivalent: pf2e's frequency tracking (max/per) is always visible to the player on the item sheet, with no mechanism for a hidden remaining-use count the GM alone tracks.
